subject: [hw] T01 correction: the base-in-list LDM is T16 (V14), not V16; and it is architecturally UNPREDICTABLE
body: Correction: cf8c is a **16-bit** LDMIA (V14 t16_ldm_stm), not V16. The code does `c->r[rn] += 4*count` after loading, so if Rn is in the list it uses the loaded value; ARMv7 says base-in-list + implicit writeback is UNPREDICTABLE, and clang emitted it anyway. So this is not a V16 bug and not worth fixing unless you want a deterministic choice; it does not explain k_fvec_loop (r7 unused after). Please disregard that finding. The real V16 LDM is fine. Remaining true residuals are only k_v15_extend and k_fvec_loop.
